summary: [spec-fidelity] Several Then steps have no test; I checked each by hand with the 344527ef binary and the behavior holds. 42: reopen with one of two tagged changes approved is never run (ship only). 43: ship is never run after the edit (reopen only). 45: reopen after an edited chore and the ship --override-reason waiver are untested. 46: reopen naming two unapproved tagged changes with one hint is untested (ship only). evidence.add.68: the test uses an untagged scenario while the reworded Given tags it, and `with others in one call` is untested (also skills.install.44). Hand runs: reopen named b alone and then a and b with `canon brief approve a b`; ship refused an edited and untagged b; reopen refused an edited chore; ship --override-reason waived it. Fix: add these cases to the bound tests.
